Author: Siddharth
Bench: Siddharth
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?In Chamber
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2633 of 2020
Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vaibhav Kaushik

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
In view of the guidelines laid down by this Court, the urgent bail applications have been directed to be heard through Video Conferencing.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA through Video Conferencing.
Perused the material on record.

The instant Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with a prayer to grant an anticipatory bail to the applicant, namely, Pradeep Kumar, in Crime/FIR No. 0118 of 2020, under Section 56 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 , Police Station - Sayana Thana, District - Bulandshahar.
Allegation against the applicant is that there was shortage in the food grains stock found by the Inspecting Officer.
The applicant is an employee of Food and Civil Supplies Department.

He was Pradeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 27 May, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140011538/
1 posted as Area Marking Officer.

sentences.text: Submission is that as per the Government Orders dated 15.9.1990 and 15.7.2005, it is mandatory to initiate departmental inquiry before proceeding against the employee alleged to be involved in such offence.
The applicant alleges false implication in this case without following procedure provided.
He has serious apprehension that he may be arrested by the police in any time.
Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicant.
Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and considering the nature of accusation and his antecedents, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case.

(v) The concerned Court/Authority/Official shall verify the authenticity of such computerized copy of the order from the official website of High Court Allahabad and shall make a declaration of such verification in writing.
In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.

The Investigating Officer is directed to conclude the investigation of the present case in accordance with law, expeditiously, independently without being prejudiced by any observations made by this Court while considering and deciding the present anticipatory bail application of the applicant.

The applicant is directed to produce a copy of this order downloaded from the official website of this Court before the S.S.P./S.P. concerned within ten days from today, who shall ensure the compliance Pradeep Kumar vs State Of U.P.
